# The Steil Group (STEIL)

> GTM-as-a-Service for B2B software and data companies.

The Steil Group, known as STEIL, is a growth agency that helps B2B software and data companies ($15–50M revenue) scale their marketing operations. Founded by Ryan "RC" Campbell, STEIL works alongside existing teams to add senior strategy and full-channel execution — integrated marketing delivered as a service.

## What STEIL Does

STEIL works across four core areas:

1. Develop an integrated marketing strategy across print, digital, conferences, and AI
2. Pressure-test GTM strategy and iterate quickly
3. Capture bottom-of-funnel traffic and establish competitive differentiation
4. Align sales and marketing for better connectivity across the GTM

## Services

- AI Ad Placement
- Google Ads
- Programmatic Display & Video
- Managed Conference Experiences
- Print Campaigns
- SEO
- AI Search Visibility
- Email & Direct Mail
- Creative & Design
- LinkedIn ABM

## Who STEIL Helps

STEIL works with CEOs, CROs, VPs of Sales, and VPs of Marketing at B2B software and data companies. Typical clients are mid-market companies ($15–50M revenue) whose marketing teams need to scale — adding strategy, channels, and execution capacity they haven't had bandwidth to staff.

## Results From Past Engagements

- +50% new-logo pipeline growth
- 7x increase in valuation
- +30% new-logo growth

Past engagements include work with HiLabs, Powerfleet, and Derive Systems.
